== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Walker Sighting (Japanese)|Walker Sighting]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/164089330/BOmGwezxiEGnZkyvsuPhEA.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 96471721.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>0759c076737165a306722b4d5e05c37a82c98fed8d602476d718a64d58ee4a49</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
